\[
\text{baseFeeDelta} = \max\left(\frac{2,400,000,000 \times 15,000,000}{15,000,000} // 8, 1\right) = 300,000,000
\]

\[
2,400,000,000 + 300,000,000 = 2,700,000,000
\]
